scientific_scope: Provisional same-organ metric chord comparisons, manually reviewed; not a completed independent accuracy evaluation or an automatic generalizable trait extractor.
policy_correction: User-measured operator annotations are valid comparison references with stated uncertainty; independent certification is not required merely to display a conditional residual. Anatomical mismatch, missing geometry, deformation and uncertain section remain material.
method: Source clicks frozen against photographs; no manual length or width used to select metric scale or point distances.
Only existing selected metric fused/cleaned vertices; 4 px source disk, full-cloud visibility and at least two of three stereo-depth checks within 12 mm with >=2 stereo votes.
Closest supported projected source point selected deterministically; every accepted endpoint visually inspected in three recorded views.
Bad anatomical matches retained as rejected attempts, including crossing stems; no arbitrary nearest point used when support absent.
Differences use user-annotated cm values. Straight natural-pose chord is not identical to flattened ruler length or a surface geodesic; width sections remain conditional.
Endpoint disk min/max range is sensitivity over candidate points, not a confidence interval.
No aggregate MAPE/MAE is presented as physical accuracy; selections are manual and provisional.
